title: A single-ligand-protected Eu60−nGd(Tb)n cluster: a reasonable new approach to expand lanthanide aggregations

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve 2,2-dimethylol propionic acid, KBr and triethanolamine in methanol, acetonitrile and deionized water. Seal in a 23 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and stir for 1 h at room temperature. Add Gd(NO3)3·6H2O and Eu(NO3)3·6H2O, heat at 160 °C for 2 days, then cool to room temperature at 10 °C h−1. Collect the rod-like colourless crystals by filtration and wash with deionized water.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature during initial stirring; 160 °C during solvothermal reaction; cooled at 10 °C h−1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature; rod-like colourless crystals collected by filtration and washed with deionized water.

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row HULSUF; Gd-containing structure and guest-solvent counts match compound 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete 60-lanthanide core–shell cluster comprising an inner Ln36 spherical kernel and outer Ln24 shell. Carbonate and μ3-OH groups organize and link the metal framework, while deprotonated 2,2-dimethylol propionic acid ligands protect its outer coordination sphere.
